name: Basic Tomato Sauce (Marinara)
steps: Warm the olive oil over medium heat; add thinly sliced garlic.
Cook until fragrant and just golden, about 1 min (don't brown).
Add the tomatoes and salt; bring to a simmer.
Simmer gently 20-30 min, stirring now and then, until thickened.
Tear in the basil, taste for salt, and serve over pasta.
notes: Makes enough for ~400 g dry pasta. Add a pinch of sugar if the tomatoes are sharp, or chilli flakes for arrabbiata.
